verdict: works first-try on SM75 (same as kev: pip-tier CUDA, no sm_75 fallback issues, torch 2.14/cu130 fine). 7 clean structural passes (en+it NER, zero-shot labels, multilabel aspects, relations, records) and one honest divergence: single-label sentiment on mixed sentences returns positive where the model card documents negative. Speed tier: 21.8 ms GPU / 78.3 ms CPU per extraction — usable as a live schema-extraction microservice. The interesting property for this lab: label definitions travel WITH the request (zero-shot labels with descriptions passed at 0.94-0.99 confidence), so one 287M model replaces a per-schema fine-tune. Total dir 6.7 GB (weights 1.15 + venv) — rotates to archive per storage rule; venv rebuild = pip install 'gliner2[local]' protobuf.
